editorial.intro: Braced high wings, faired wheels and rounded cabin windows run through these Cessna light aircraft illustrations. Citation jets, twin propeller transports and older training aircraft add different engine and cockpit arrangements to the collection.
paragraphs: Braced high wings, faired wheels and rounded cabin windows run through these Cessna light aircraft illustrations. Citation jets, twin propeller transports and older training aircraft add different engine and cockpit arrangements to the collection.

There are {{artworkCount}} artworks covering parked aircraft, flying profiles, overhead views and black and white outlines. The descriptions distinguish visible tailwheel layouts, nose wheels, rear engines and tandem or side by side cabins. They avoid assigning an exact variant from paint or filename alone.
